name: Singi-Kaitumjaure
description: Singi to Kaitumjaure. Check current trail, access and service notices before departure.
waterSources: No verified potable water source is listed for this section; carry water and treat natural water.
notes: STF lists 4-5 hours; Naturkartan Swedish/API evidence lists 4-6 hours and English text was reported as 5-6 hours.
STF labels this as stage 3 of the Nikkaluokta-Saltoluokta route group; OSM labels relation 17080115 as Kungsleden Etapp 10; this project candidate is section 6 on the Abisko-Hemavan mainline.

Official/rules lanes initially did not confirm a protected-area overlap. Coordinator WFS checks found Torne och Kalix alvsystem at the Tjaktjajakka bridge and Sjaunja in a broad route bbox, but not in point checks at endpoints or bridge for land reserve.
STF's Nikkaluokta-Saltoluokta page still labels Vakkotavare-Kebnats bus as FlixBus, while current 2026 operator pages point to Road to Ritsem/Falcks Omnibus.
AllTrails 2024 tags conflict: 2024-08-27 says poor conditions while 2024-09-02 says great conditions, with no detailed explanation.
Run final protected-area/Natura 2000 overlay against selected section geometry before rules normalization, especially for Sjaunja/Sjavnja, Kaitum fjallurskog and Torne och Kalix alvsystem.

facilities.name: STF Kaitumjaure Mountain Cabin
facilities.description: Remote STF hut at the section end. Two guest cabins, 30 beds, sauna, small shop, self-catering kitchen, limited pet rooms, one dog-allowed guest cabin, no mobile coverage and host phone/call time.
facilities.routeProximity: endpoint; about 0.6 m from OSM endpoint and about 20.4 m from Naturkartan route endpoint

facilities.name: STF Singi Mountain Cabin
facilities.description: Remote STF hut at the section start and trail junction. Three guest cabins, 44 beds, self-catering kitchen, limited pet rooms, no mobile coverage and no shop. Shared endpoint facility with section 5 and connector/access routes.
facilities.routeProximity: start; about 27-30 m from route geometry endpoint depending on source

facilities.name: Tjaktjajakka suspension bridge
facilities.coordinateSource: OSM bridge center with STF/Naturkartan official bridge text support
facilities.description: Suspension bridge over Tjaktjajakka about 3 km north of Kaitumjaure. Official sources use it as a route landmark before the more awkward, boardwalked approach to Kaitumjaure.
facilities.routeProximity: on route; about 9.08 km from Singi and about 3.2 km before Kaitumjaure
